Some baking powder is bulked with wheat starch.

stands_in_for.caveat: It is weaker, so use more, and the lift is gentler.

ingredient/black-pepper.behaviour: Gives heat and aroma that fade with long cooking and turn harsh when scorched, so most of it goes in near the end.

ingredient/butter.behaviour: Melts, foams as its water boils off, then its milk solids brown and soon burn. Whisked cold into a hot liquid, it thickens it and makes it glossy.

contains.basis: It is made from cream.

stands_in_for.caveat: The milk solids in butter burn at the heat these need, and leave a bitter taste.

A cook who has no white wine often reaches for it in a cream sauce or a fish dish.

Its fruity flavour changes the finish. Keep it below the point where it smokes.
